method.orientation: samples/cartridges are rows; spectral channels are columns
method.floating_point: Python binary64, math.fsum, stable max-shift logsumexp
method.svd: NumPy descriptive SVD only; no mechanism or statistical significance inferred
method.normalization_targets: uniform probability row and column targets on each selected normalization domain
method.factor_comparison: each log-sample factor is re-centered on the same comparison rows before comparison
method.uncertainty: No peak-area covariance/background/replicate errors supplied; no statistical uncertainty calculated
method.77_keV_status: Nominal unresolved ROI; kept as a positive channel with no guessed photon yield
